title: Remove core code nothing calls that Susi Commercial Apps now carries
goal: Vision: V-10. Mandate 84. susi-gawd-agents cloud_budget.rs and cloud_intent.rs, susi-gmcp mcp_probe.rs and mcp_profile.rs (with their tests), and susi-core model_health.rs have no caller in core outside their own tests. Susi Commercial Apps carries them with their tests (commercial T-CORESIZEFIX-5). Remove them here, re-point the VC-201-086 and VC-202-020 verdicts, and lower COMPLETE_SOCKET_CEILING.

reuse.searched: a survey of core modules whose only callers are entry points or nothing; these five have no caller outside their own tests.

limitations: Lands after the MCP fallback deletion (core T-CORESIZEVAULT-14) so the ceiling is lowered from its value. Windows x86_64 first.
